notes.title: Patch v1.2017.11.29 on the way!
notes.content:
Hi All,

I'm about to release a patch this week, and there are quite a few additions to this one:

[b]Robbery Indicators[/b] - If you've selected the Rookie as an Alias (obtainable by bringing 5 Robbers to the Police Station), you will see on-screen alerts as to which direction crimes are being committed.

[b]Injury Indicators[/b] - If you've selected the First Responder as an Alias (obtainable by bringing 5 injured to the Hospital), you will see on-screen alerts as to which direction injured people are located.

[b]Fire Indicators[/b] - All Aliases will not see on-screen alerts as to which direction fires are located.

[b]Melee Overhauled[/b] 
[list]
[*]I reworked the melee hit-box system (it is no longer based on the player's sprite).  
[*]You can now hit Rats, Aliens, and some Bosses.  Cops still don't like to see you swinging your fists, so be careful!  
[*]Cops and Enforcers will now swing at you when they are close and upset enough.
[/list]

[b]More Havok[/b] - The giant robot Antagotron will now attack windows in addition to City Equipment that keeps citizens safe.  This creates fires and victims yelling for help.

[b]New Builder Alias[/b] - You can now find the Builder Alias in City Hall.  It has the ability to use the Equipment Hopper near City Hall.  Create Detour Signs to replace what the Antagotron has destroyed.  More features coming to this Alias soon. 

Hopefully this will be out by tomorrow!


Thanks for playing! :)

-Jeff

notes.title: Patch v1.2017.11.18c
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This patch is currently in the Beta line (which is publicly available), and should be released very soon.  Some of its features include:

[list]

[*][b]Boss Indicators[/b] - You will now be able to see where the bosses are located (currently only 2)
[*][b]Fame[/b] - In addition to cash, you now can also earn Fame.  It doesn't do anything yet, but in future releases it will start to effect the strength of both your allies and enemies once that dynamic has been added to the game.  
[*][b]Score Effects[/b] - Earning Fame or Cash will display in an arcade style.  For instance; when you either grab and imprison criminals, or grab and bring the injured to the hospital, you will now see cash and fame effects appear in the game screen.
[*][b]Factory Location added[/b] - The Mecha-Alien level is now located in the Factory... and is now where the Cleaner Alias is employed.
[*][b]Some Bug Fixes[/b]

[/list]

[b]You may need to refresh the world for this one... so if things seem extra wonky, go ahead and give that a shot.[/b]

And don't forget, if you would like to help support this project, please visit my [url=https://www.patreon.com/simpledistractions]Patreon[/url] page and subscribe!

Thanks all!

-Jeff

notes.title: Small Patch v1.2017.11.10
notes.content:
Hey all,

This update just has a few changes revolving around text.  

I'm in the process of converting the Arial font to ones that fit a more comic style.  A "handwriting" font has been added for most of the text you see.  Please let me know what you think about it... I'm not fully sold yet.  There will be more coming soon, specifically for the city management info panel. 

To accomodate the new text's sizing, I changed and cleaned up some of the in-game verbage.

More coming!

-Jeff

notes.title: Patch v1.2017.11.2c
notes.content:
Hi all!

YOU WILL NEED TO RESET YOUR WORLD FOR THIS UPDATE

In this release:

[list]
[*]ADD: City Panel - You now can see the city's stats. Instructions comming for this feature in a future update.
[*]ADD: First Responder Alias - Bring 5 injured to the hospital to unlock this.
[*]ADD: Rookie Alias - Bring 5 Robbers to the Police Department to unlock this.
[*]CHANGE: Event tweaks - Events now randomly spawn once per day. You won't be able to help everyone, unless you have selected the right abilities to do so.
[*]BUG: You will now see aliens during an invasion.
[/list]

Thanks for playing... and for your support!

-Jeff

notes.title: First Release Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Welcome to the first release of SUPER!  

*PLEASE REMEMBER THIS GAME IS IN ALPHA*    ^.^

The ultimate idea of SUPER is to provide an open world where you can explore and grow the city in the direction you choose... while playing minigames to unlock Origins, Aliases, and Abilities for future characters.

Currently, all of the Origins and Aliases are in the game.  However, most of them are in a place-holder state... just ready to grab.  In future releases, you will need to complete tasks to gain unlockables.

Please report any of the many bugs to the Stream Forums for this game.

Enjoy, and thank you!

-Jeff
